Once you reach Tetragorn's lair, you must destroy the headstones that trigger him. Once he has appeared, destroy him with your wisp, but above all you must avoid contact. Again, this stage takes place on 5 levels of increasing difficulty.

170937.overview: A train simulation with a touch of train management but focused on the train engineer experience.

170974.overview:
Far away in a distant galaxy, the planet Silenus has become the latest victim of the Hordes of Pterelaus - a confederacy of evil beings intent on domination all other lifeforms. After a long and bitter battle, the Pterelaens enveloped the planet in an impenetrable force-field and the surviving Silenian tribes were forced to retreat to Euboea, a city deep beneath the surface of the sacred Antileon lake. 

The Silenian elders have approved a daring plan. Leaving the sanctuary of Euboea, the boldest worriors will undertake a long and hazardous journey towards a final rallying point far above the planet. After negotiating the Caves of Dicte (a maze of interconnecting tunnels infested with mutants and enemy devices), they will emerge on the Tegean plains where they must make their way to the only window through the planet's force-field - above the Pterelaen stronghold in the Brauron mountains. 
 
If they can survive, their aim is to regroup in space to launch one final, desperate assault on the Pterelaens' mother-ship. For now, though, they must concentrate on making their 'Escape from Euboea". 
 
Having prayed to the Goddess Nemesis for guidance and protection in his arduous quest, the first warrior is launched through the airlock....

170991.overview: The ring cycle in text adventure form with graphics. German Language only.

171041.overview: Nightmare Park is a top down single screen game where you have to enter a park from the top of the screen and get to the exit at the bottom of the screen through a simple maze. You can move in a 90 degree direction, and as you go through the maze you will come across a random mini-game. These games are simple single screen games and these include avoiding rampaging rhinos, guess the name of a gorilla and get into a safe position from lasers. If you complete a game then you carry on through the park but if you fail then it is game over.

171047.overview: A cooperative ninja shoot-em-up written in Chris Yates' SEUCK.  Developed by the trio of Albert Pluns, József Hajdú & Tamás Németh and published by Novo Soft

171049.overview: Niterider is a top view driving game where the screen scrolls vertically upwards constantly as you move your Trans-Am around the screen avoiding obstacles and other vehicles in the desert. You are being harassed by Hell's Angels and these move from the top or the bottom of the screen as well as cars that move down the screen. Cactus and water need avoiding and if you touch any obstacle or vehicle then you lose one of five lives. You are armed with oil-slicks and these can be used to destroy the bikes and if you destroy six bikes then you move up a level but you lose 50 points for every one used.

171050.overview:
It kills.
   It is not Human.
         But it Exists. 
 110 locations, animated graphics, more than 35 objects to be examined. An icon driven adventure, making use of pointers and drop down menus. Comprising several integrated arcade games. Multiple and interactive characters.

171094.overview: A North Sea platform is menaced by terrorists, they have taken hostages and they have placed a nuclear bomb somewhere, attempting to extort the government. You are ordered as a special agent to free the hostages and to defuse the bomb. But you are not helpless because you can dispose of some different weapons. You only have 30 minutes to fulfill your mission. ON the way you are led through a labyrinth of corridors, stairs, lifts and rooms, this means that this mission demands intelligence, good reactions and a good orientation.

171112.overview:
2 Players control 8 little aliens each to battle in several single screen arenas. There is no plot to the game, it just is quick 2 player action. Gameplay is simple, each player has 8 aliens, but only one is controlled at any given time. Which one is controlled can be switched by pressing the joystick button. Then the aliens are cycled through one by one. The movement is on a fixed grid and 4-directional. Adjacent aliens either hurt each other or heal each other, depending on whether they are enemies or friends. Slain aliens leave corpses for a while. The hurt/heal effect is 8-directional, so you have to keep your diagonals protected as well.

Whoever kills all enemy aliens first wins. There are 7 different arenas to choose from and the game also has an AI mode for when no human opponent is available.

171129.overview:
An upgrade and enhancement on the original version. 2 Players control 8 little aliens each to battle in several single screen arenas. There is no plot to the game, it just is quick 2 player action. Gameplay is simple, each player has 8 aliens, but only one is controlled at any given time. Which one is controlled can be switched by pressing the joystick button. Then the aliens are cycled through one by one. The movement is on a fixed grid and 4-directional. Adjacent aliens either hurt each other or heal each other, depending on whether they are enemies or friends. Slain aliens leave corpses for a while. The hurt/heal effect is 8-directional, so you have to keep your diagonals protected as well.

Whoever kills all enemy aliens first wins. There are 7 different arenas to choose from and the game also has an AI mode for when no human opponent is available.
Also published in Commodore Format (Issue #64).

171147.overview: The NORAD super computer has taken control of the Nuclear Defense system and is about to indulge itself in starting the war to end all wars. All the top brass are convinced that nothing is wrong; the only exception is Dr. Norton, a very absent-minded person, who has been sacked for voicing his opinions about MASTA (the NORAD computer). He has talked to MASTA and has the code which on insertion into MASTA will stop the War: unfortunately, he has forgotten this code but he can remember that a ditty he made up is very important in that it gives clues to enable a person to stop MASTA.

171294.overview:
Nightfighter is a simple shooter programmed entirely in BASIC. It was developed by Humphrey Walwyn and Published in 1983 by Pan Books/Person Computer News in the book Sixty Programs for the Commodore 64.

You have lost the rest of your bomber squadron and are flying back to base all on your own. In the distance is an enemy plane. You're the tail-end Charlie, and as the first of your foes closes in  you've got to get him in your cross-hairs and blast him out of the skies. You can fire a second burst only after the first has run its cours, and the enemy will weave about more on their run-ins as your score rises.

171777.overview:
A vertical scrolling futuristic blaster.
Yep, it's one of those cool SEUCK space blasters (My all time favourite genre of games), in which you fly through the deep voids of space, and fight against the evil aliens, and blast away having a good time. This time, you fly through a crystal world, doing battle against an evil machine, and its creator, and many of its minions. Go on, have a good blast. I'm sure you SEUCK fans will want to. Along with a breathtaking front end and a brand new T.N.D tape loader tune, "Let Me Go Home" with my own colourful, but old-school style loader bitmap.

172787.overview:
This computer coloring book is another part in the Electric Crayon series and it has 30 pictures featuring 1-10 numbers. Each picture includes the number of certain items, this number as digit written in some way and this number written as word (for example, three rabbits in the three magic hats or ten bones for a dog) with famous characters from Sesame Street to color.

Pictures could be colored from a palette of 16 colors. A mix button would "mix" the current color with the 15 other colors and give a total of 256 colors. Choosing a color and clicking in the picture do a color fill in the area clicked. The finished, or in progress, coloring was automatically saved to disk. Player may also remove all colors applied previously to start coloring from the very beginning.

Pictures could be printed with or without a monthly calendar, description, or message.

172873.overview: Published in Game On 1989/06. In this Platform shooter first search for the key, use the teleport lifts. Open the door with the key and go in the transverat. Never touch a sprite or a mine, never ever go in a deathzone.

172875.overview:
Pacman played upside down and backwards.

This is actually a hacked version of the c64 Pac-Man clone, Munch Mania.

172876.overview: Nanako in Classic Japanese Monster Castle is an adult 2D puzzle platform game. It is the third game in the Classic Japanese Monster Castle series, but the first to introduce Nanako as the protagonist as well as an adult theme. Initially released for the ZX Spectrum, it was rewritten from scratch for CPC by the same developers as a new team (called v2) and then also C64. The differences between the two versions are mainly in the visual presentation. The adult elements are only present in the loading and ending screens, not during the game itself. Nanako's sister Mya is a witch apprentice and broke the rules of her mentor. She leaves and heads to Heún Tower where she wants to improve her knowledge in dark magic. She breaks into the tower, angering an army of Karakasas and Tzukogamis (inanimate objects which become conscious after they are more than 100 years old), so she has to flee and hole up in the top of the tower. Nanako becomes worried after her sister's disappearance and follows her path through her mental connection with her sister. To bring her back to a safe place and reach her Nanako has to complete 25 rooms. Each room consists of a single-screen environment. They are linked vertically using the flip-screen mechanic to form a tower. The goal is simply to reach the top of the room each time, but this requires some environment based puzzle-solving. Next to dodging enemies Nanako also has to build her own path by picking up and dropping boxes to reach the top. Only one box can be carried at all times. Not all enemies are awake. Still Karakasa can also be used as temporary platforms, but there is a chance they wake up and then she drops down. Another technique allows Nanako to jump and drop a box in mid-air, creating a floating platform. Nanako starts with five lives. A password for each level is providing after completing it, using a custom Kun alphabet.

172877.overview:
Napoleon at Waterloo is a real-time strategy game which covers the battle of Waterloo (1815).The player controls Napoleon Bonaparte's army and has to defeat the enemy.

At first glance, the game has the distinctive look of a wargame: a top-down map with abstract symbols representing the terrain and units. However, everything is in real-time and therefore the complexity has been toned down. The only thing the player does is giving move orders by choosing a unit and moving the cursor to the place it should move to. Those orders are not carried out instantly; each movement takes a certain amount of time depending on terrain and unit type. Battles are initiated automatically when a unit moves close to a hostile. Then they basically exchange blows until one unit lost all of its soldiers. The game also factors in fatigue and morale.

The time is measured with an in-game clock and a match ends after eleven hours (30 minutes in real-time). If the player has won a match depends on the reached score which is based on the casualties.

172904.overview: Created in 1996 by Stealth Labwork. This game has you guide your spacepod through several miles of underground caverns where you must avoid touching the walls or you will lose one of the few lives given. Your score goes up for every second you are not smashed to smithereens.

172905.overview: A text adventure where you are on a search for the Nectar of the gods. The magical wine which makes you immortal. You start in a second floor hotel room in modern day Athens. From your window you can see the ruins of the Acropolis.

172906.overview: An Italian multi coin, slot machine game by Nemo Galletti and published by Systems Editoriale s.r.l. in 1985 in Commodore Club n.6.

172907.overview:
The banker Mr. Klinkoyn has misplaced four treasures throughout his nine-room house and he has called upon you to locate and return them. Nellan the cat, in the meantime, is thirsty, and would be thrilled were you to bring her a big bowl full of cool milk. Relying upon the assistance of a magic map and the friendly denizens of the house, the player types in instructions intending to fulfill the above goals in this self-stated game of "let's pretend"... all within 72 scoots -- an internal time limit.

This is a conversion of a TRS-80 game of the same name.

172909.overview: Net Nut is a grid capture game similar to Amidar or the ZX Spectrum game Cruisin' on Broadway for the Commodore 64. It was released in 1984 by Swedish company, ScandSoft

172910.overview: Released in preview form, the overall intent of the game was to be a straight Doom clone, as this is how the game was sold on their website, however it never progressed to that point and previews more like an exploration game. It was released in Commodore Scene #31 in its sadly unfinished state.

172923.overview: Race against opponents across the net, has IRC support!

172928.overview:
Published in Magic Disk 64 1988/09.

Neutmare is a pong style game for head-to-head play for 1 or 2 players. Perhaps you can still remember the first video games and the 'tennis' game module that was so popular at the time. 'Neutmare' is a beefed up version of this popular game. Above all, the great music that plays in the background makes playing a real pleasure. After loading, you have two options: You can either play against the wall alone, or you can start with two people.

Should you prefer to play alone, you will have to score a certain number of points in each line-up until you advance to the next level. In TWO-PLAYER mode, the winner is the one who is the first to score 15 points.

172929.overview:
A boxing game for 0 to 2 simultaneous players, released as Megabox in Go Games n.13 (October 1986). A boxing match where you fight against a champion guided by the computer or against a second participant. I want a good, clean fight so touch globes and go back to your corners and when the bell rings come out swinging. 

Published as Megabox in Italy in Go Games n.13 (Ottobre 1986).

172930.overview: It was just supposed to be a temporary name and then Proj was sick for a few days and it went out like that. Watch your deadlines, folks. Seriously, this was a game that you could load and play quickly (just 98 blocks) while the real game you purchased on cassette was taking forever to load into memory.

172931.overview: 20 fresh, NEW caves to explore from Prof. Knibble.

172939.overview: Nibbly '92 is a worm/nibble/snake game, where the player controls a growing snake while eating dots in an enclosed maze. The maze is contained on a single screen, and the snake must eat all the dots without being blocked by its own body, in order to get to the next screen with a new maze. When sixteen levels have been played, the game repeats the mazes with more difficulty for the player by increasing the snake growth, until eventually the maze becomes impossible to solve. This game is the predecessor to Super Nibbly. Game On 1992/02, Game On GE 1993/1.

172940.overview:
Arc Developments created a 3D game world called Reality3 for this simulation, licensed around one of Britain's top players. There are two courses, plus a hidden 9-hole course on Mars with reduced gravity, with match play and stroke play options against one of 8 varied-difficulty computer players.

The control system is quite unusual, as the strength of the shot is chosen before you start the swing, but you have to click within a range to activate the shot, and this range is narrower if your shot is intended to be more powerful. An extra click can be made to add wrist snap, which increases the shot's power. The wind calculation is more complicated than most games of the era, and the rough is harder to play out of than usual, as you can't make slight stance adjustments easily.

172941.overview: You are in a very short-lived shooting gallery, with only 30 seconds to shoot as many nick-nacks as you can. Be careful, though, because at higher levels, some of them shoot back! Released in 1983 by Alpha Software Ltd. and made by AVL..

172943.overview: Night Driver is an action racing game which takes place at night! Your goal is to score as many points as possible by racing through one of four different tracks. Points are scored by passing checkpoints located throughout the track. If your car crashes into the side of the road, oncoming cars, or any other obstacles, you will lose all of your speed and a lot of time! The game ends when the 90 second time limit is up. The four tracks you can choose from are beginner, pro, expert, and random (this track is different every time and can not be memorized like the other three). Several game options are included which allows you to select whether or not other cars will honk before entering the screen, and choose between a 90 second or infinite amount of time for a game.

172944.overview:
You are a Night Fighter whose mission is to encounter and destroy as many of Earth's alien attackers as possible. The aliens get faster and more sinister at the higher levels, so be on your guard at all times!

A vertically scrolling shooter where you can shoot forward or to the sides.

172948.overview: Published in Commodore Free #074, this game, somewhat similar to Green Beret, is a horizontally scrolling shooter created by Alf Yngve using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit.

172966.overview: A Brain\Logic puzzle published as a game of the "Cassette 50" collection. Nim is a mathematical game of strategy in which two players take turns removing (or "nimming") objects from distinct heaps or piles. On each turn, a player must remove at least one object, and may remove any number of objects provided they all come from the same heap or pile. Depending on the version being played, the goal of the game is either to avoid taking the last object or to take the last object.

172967.overview:
An adventure with text and graphics. Many centuries ago the Grey Ninja stole the statue of Jozen away from their arch enemies, the Kubuto Ninja Clan, and installed it in the Temple of Sharloon. Over the years many attempts were made to return the statue, but to no avail.

Now you've been chosen to try where all others have failed...

Your only assistance is a clue said to be hidden in a poem written in the Fifth Century by the poet Shimito. Now as you enter the dark Dragon Head Forest, deep within Grey Ninja Territory you wonder if you have made the correct decision. Well, my friend, you will need all your skill and cunning to survive this one.

172968.overview: You are a reporter, who has just been assigned to New Orleans to try to crack a heroin smuggling ring known to be operating along the waterfront. Arriving with $500, your goal is to befriend the strange denizens of nighttime New Orleans, and try to solve the case. Night Walker is an adventure game where you explore a map of the New Orleans waterfront, visiting different locations to gather clues. When the player enters a building, they go into text mode, where they can answer yes/no questions to advance the story. They can also make observations, which can be used to query other characters at a later date. There is also an inventory system, and the player can bribe characters from their limited funds. The player can enter all buildings only once, and must gather clues during this encounter. If they miss important clues, they can not reenter a building, making it essential to visit buildings in the correct order. The TRS-80 version has a 2-dimensional map represent the New Orleans waterfront, while the Commodore 64 uses a 3-dimensional display. Otherwise there are no differences between gameplay or story.

172981.overview: A SEUCK based, single player, vertically scrolling shooter for beginners with some sprites poached from Avenger, created by Champion Software. The year of creation is currently unknown. Shoot the ninjas and the spiders. Pick up weapons, treasure and potions.

172982.overview: A horizontally scrolling space shoot'em up created by  Robin Lennon and Shaun Morris. Published in Italy as Raid in both New Special PlayGames n.46 (febbraio 1992) and Hit Parade C64 n.67 (Maggio 1992). A new alien threat looms on the horizon of our solar system. To crush this umpteenth invasion, the Federation commissions its most skilled interstellar fighter pilot to disintegrate the mighty enemy army. Having reached the expected rendezvous for our friend, all that remains is to insert the photonic lasers and fight against the endless hordes of aliens that will attack him mercilessly. Your task will be precisely to defend the entire solar system: so be prepared to hit everything that moves, to avoid any contact with other objects and you will see that in the end, victory will smile at you. Good luck!

172999.overview: A simple avoid it style game.

173000.overview: No Deeper Meaning is a puzzle game created by Twice Effect and published in Game On 1992/06. Switch and flip tiles to find matches in ways that does not strand other tiles.

173001.overview: An overhead racing game Tiger-Crew-Disk #020 (11/1995) featuring amazing Porsche racing.

173002.overview: Nocturno is a puzzle solving game, featuring 99 levels. Each level requires reaching the end spot by jumping on proper tiles before the time runs out. There are several types of tiles, differing in the way and direction of the ball's rebound. Jumping off from the tile causes immediate disappearance of it. Falling from a tile means a loss of life.

173003.overview: A fantasy themed text only adventure. Later simple graphics would be added and it would be re-released as Maze of Nogard. Your king is at war and as an elite Nogard warrior you have been chosen to bring six items to him as he hides in his storeroom under a bed. You have only your official Nogard Warrior surplus Warlord Battlepack (a plastic bag), a newspaper and a pair of clean undies!

173009.overview: A shooter, created by Mike Poullas that is part of "Sky Fighters" game pack. Who says being a buccaneer doesn't pay? The question should be, will it pay enough? That is what you, Nomad, the space pirate, want to find out as you twist and turn through the outer reaches of the galaxy. You must evade those who want your hard earned cargo of precious metals. Beware, the more ore you recover, the more determined your foes become! The further you go, the more obstacles you must avoid. Can you survive as a space pirate?

173010.overview:
A strategy train simulation management game covering the Baltimore northwest corridor area of tracks. NORTHEAST CORRIDOR - The ultimate in
railroad traffic control simulations. Recently released for Commodore 64, Northeast Corridor addresses 325 track miles which lie between Washington, D.C. and Wilmington, Delaware. The volume of traffic, the variety of interlockings and track configurations. and the interesting mix of high speed passenger and lower speed freight trains on the territory combine to present a formidable control challenge for the user who plays the role of a sole dispatcher trying to keep passenger trains on time, prevent bottle- necks, and, in general, keep traffic flowing smoothly.

173012.overview: Another title from the notorious Cassette 50. This one is a variation of the popular pen and paper game Noughts and Crosses (or better known in North America as Tic-Tac-Toe)

173013.overview: Not to be confused with the Infogrames title of the same name, although the gameplay is somewhat similar, North & South! by  Octagon is a homebrewed game that was somewhat inspired by that particular title. It was developed by Christian Larsen and published by Octagon in 1990.

173029.overview: Nova follows a similar premise as Deflektor, that is, the player has to manipulate one or more beams of light in such a way that they reach a certain spot. This can be done by placing tiles on the playing field. There are tiles that change the direction of a beam by 90 degrees, blocks that cannot be penetrated, blocks that are destroyed by the light and slow it down for a moment, tubes that allow the light to pass through itself and "bubbles" that break the light and send it off into two different directions. The type of tiles available and the total number of tiles the player is allowed to use differs from level to level. Published in Game On 1993/12.

173030.overview: Nova Blast is a side-scrolling sci-fi shooter in which you must defend four shielded cities from invaders that attack from both in the air and on the ground. Each city has a bubble shield that can sustain one hit; another hit to an unshielded city will destroy it. Players control a ship that can fire lasers horizontally and drop bomb vertically. The ship is also equipped with an energy beam that can absorb energy from energy tanks, and can also use that energy to create temporary shields around unprotected cities. The ship can also sustain up to ten blows in each round. If all four cities are destroyed or the ship takes ten hits in a round, the game ends. Nova Blast is a single player game with three difficulty levels.

173031.overview:
A Shoot'em Up - SEUCK based vertical space battle game. It seems that all is now lost on the distant planet Deimos, the Rutilians have managed to reach the interplanetary base where the access and defense codes are kept. Nothing can be done to arrest them. But a scientist from the super-confederacy has created a new Nova-Proton weapon, a new experimental ship that autonomously governed, therefore free from computer ties, could be able to infiltrate the enemy defense network, fight their cruisers and fighters, destroy their missile bases and turn the tables. But for such a high tech ship, a special and highly skilled pilot is also required. You as a member of Odin, have been chosen to lead this Nova Force on this difficult mission, to restore peace and tranquility to Deimos, but also to save all humanity from a huge disaster. 

Published in Italy as Odino in Special Program n.46 (settembre 1988) and later in Hit Parade C64 n.30 (Gennaio 1989).

173032.overview: A SEUCK space shooter created by Dr. Ice of IRS.

173033.overview:
A Space Invaders style shoot'em up. Published in Italy as Stronghold in Formula 64 n.48. 
 
You have a small ship, from which it is possible to develop a considerable volume of fire with the weapons at your disposal. It can move and dodge horizontally to the left and right. From above come the threats made up of seven different types of attackers. By firing at these adversaries you will first need to take out their defenses. If the aliens reach the surface then we are doomed and you'll have lost your life. Lives lost to cannon fire can regenerate a few times, but touching the earth is a final ending. Be strong, brave protector!

173034.overview: The crazed General K.A. Boom has set the computers into motion and is intent on blowing up the world. It is your job to stop Gen. Boom from accomplishing this dirty deed. Be careful. The general doesn't like intruders!! Good luck!!

173035.overview:
An educational game teaching math using bowling as the exciting background to keep interest levels up. Education/Math Skills-Ages 11 and Up. 
Written by leaders in educational publishing. Number Bowling helps children master the basics of fraction and decimal skills. In the motivating context of bowling competition, children must solve decimal and fraction problems as the clock counts down. Answering a problem correctly in two seconds or less means a strike, so there's no time to spare! Children experience the pride of success while mastering some of the skills necessary for high school math.

Children will:
•Understand the relationship between fractions and decimals
• Learn to calculate quickly and accurately
• Improve problem solving skills
• Willingly spend hours on math practice
Features
•Formats for one or two players
• Built-in clock that promotes quick thinking
• Interesting graphics
• Easy to use game design

173036.overview:
Number Tumblers is an educational game teaching mathematics. The game is played on a network of tumblers, cubes with either numbers or signs on them, where the player controls a creature called Wumblechum who has to jump between the tumblers to reach target numbers. After jumping on a + sign each number cube that gets jumped on is added and in the same way numbers are subtracted after jumping on a - sign. There are also multiplication and division signs. There are five target numbers and once one has been reached the counter is reset and the player starts working towards another one.

The game can be played by one or two players. In the single player mode it's possible to play alone in a solitaire mode or against an AI opponent in a computer challenge. The two player mode can be played either simultaneously or by alternating.

173038.overview:
Published in Italy as Snocciolando in Special C64 n.6 (1991/1992). 

The focus of this game are nuts of different colors which are arranged in two square containers. Your task is to reproduce the same arrangement of the right square in the left. While you cannot move a single nut, you must move a whole vertical or horizontal row at the same time. To move you position the cursor with the nut of the chosen row, hit the button and move your joystick in the desired direction. You have a time limit for each section so most fast if you want to move to the next level.

173065.overview: Part 2 of the Nyaaaah game set 'Game 2000' aka the Millennium episode of this SEUCK shoot'em\lick'em up game.

173067.overview: This adventure formed the basis of Tony Collins' later games Methyhel and Methyhel - The Special Edition.  Essentially, you are a P.I. who specializes in the world of the occult.  The story starts with you in your office where you have to piece together the information found in the envelope on your desk.  The main puzzles in Part I are broken down into finding out where to go, an interesting concept, but a sometimes tedious one.

173083.overview: S.E.U.C.K. meets Zen? Can it be done? Yes! Nervana follows the path of transcendental meditation as a pious monk rises above worldly matters (here symbolized by fire-spitting demons), going through the successive stages of enlightenment, ultimately reaching the uttermost insight.

173729.overview: An educational math game for children age 6 years upwards. How can you make learning multiplication tables fun for your child? Tablesums is a cassette containing two computer programs, Tablesums 1 and 2, which aid in the teaching of tables in an exciting and motivating way. Both programs allow the child the choice of which table to practice from 1 to 10, whether the computer is to answer, or the choice of a mixed table. The main section of the program displays a running score total, with correct answers rewarded and wrong answers penalized. After 20 goes the final total is shown on the screen in a novel way and you may play again. Simply follow the instructions given in the booklet included and let Tablesums take the drudgery out of learning tables.

173854.overview:
Nederlandse Topografie is an educational computer game which teaches the locations and names of cities and places in The Netherlands.

The game contains a map of The Netherlands with many names and locations of cities, towns, lakes, rivers, regions and provinces. There are 3 modes, which are Opzoeken (Look up), Overhoring (Quiz), Het Stedenspel (The City Game), and 4 difficulty levels. In Look Up mode you can type names of a city or river and the game will point it out on the map. In Quiz mode, the game will point at a randomly selected place and the player must type in the name within the time limit. The input is very strict, if the player makes a typo and misspells even just one letter it is considered incorrect.

The helicopter mode is the main part of the game. In this mode the game randomly displays the name of a city or location, and the player controls a helicopter which must fly to that location before the time runs out. When the helicopter is close enough to the target city or location, it will turn into a pulsating red dot. Each correct city or location is one point, get 5 errors and the game ends.

In Quiz mode or The City Game, after 15 points the game goes to a higher difficulty level and it will start selecting less common cities, smaller towns and more obscure rivers.

173939.overview:
Tsushima is a strategic and tactical simulation for one or two players and recreates the climactic naval battle of the Russo-Japanese War, Tsushima, where the Japanese Fleet defeated the Russian Baltic Fleet in the Straits of Tsushima on May 27, 1905.

Tsushima provides both a strategic (with tactical combat) and tactical (combat only) scenario. Each strategic turn in the game represents one hour and each tactical turn represents five minutes.

In the 2 player game the player takes control of the Imperial Japanese Fleet with the objective of destroying the Russian Fleet before it can enter Vladivostok. The solitaire game can be played as the Commander of the Russian Baltic Fleet only and your objective is to get your ships to Vladivostok.

There are 29 major warships represented in the game and you can design your own scenarios. The game can last from 15 minutes for a tactical battle to 3 hours for the campaign game. The game is rated 6 of 10 (intermediate) on Avalon Hills' complexity scale.

173981.overview: Two learning games in one convenient cartridge. Once your children grab hold of these games, they'll play 'em for years. NUMBER NABBER builds arithmetic skills, while SHAPE GRABBER develops the young child's ability to identify a variety of shapes. Both games come with music and sound effects so lively, you'll find yourself grabbing for a chance to play a few rounds.

174373.overview: A sequel to, and an improvement on the original Space Invaders style shoot'em up game. Like the last one, you do not have static shield\blockade defenses but the enemy does have them and they move with the invaders from space. Published in Italy and released in the Alga Soft 1988 n.9b retail compilation.

176481.overview:
The Nine Moons is a Commodore 64 side-scrolling shooter developed by Jeremyl Thorne. The year of release is currently unknown. 

This game plays similar to Scramble, however instead of a spaceship, your character is a man/android with a jetpack and a laser. 

The game also has no color other than black, white, and grey.(although there is a little bit of blue in some of the stars/planets in the game's intro screen. 
 
Released under the name I Due Mondi in Italy's Special Program n.34 (luglio/agosto 1987) and Hit Parade C64 n.20 (Febbraio 1988).

176900.overview:
Released in TPUG Magazine, as part of "Fun in Learning" game pack and in Keypunch Software's Adventure Quest IV collection. 

A phrase is provided with all letters indicated by spaces; players can guess one letter at a time in an attempt to fill in enough gaps to be able to guess the phrase. Up to 15 letters can be guess and there is a 15 second time limit between guesses.

177067.overview: Do you remember the game Nucleo 447 from 2019. If you haven't then why not check out the Official C64 SEUCK Compo 2019. As this game was originally released as a competition entry last year. It was also a shame that this game missed out on the top 3. Still, moving on to 2020. Leonardo Vettori tweaks the game and brings this exclusive release for The New Dimension. Nucleo 448 is an updated version of Nucleo 447. It is a brilliant vertical scrolling SEUCK REDUX sci-fi shoot 'em up, now featuring aiming aliens, new status panel and also power ups. Messages far from outer space has been translated by a mad scientist. An asteroid is hurtling towards your home planet. You have been assigned to stop it. Unaware about the consequences, you venture into the asteroid ready to fight the aliens, and the asteroid's creator. Can you fight against the machine, and work out who, or what is behind this threat?

177439.overview:
No-Frills Dice is a simple single player dice based gambling game published by Howard W. Sams & Co. as a type-in program in the book Commodore 64 BASIC Programs.

It was developed by Timothy Orr Knight and Darren LaBatt (who also wrote the book)

180087.overview:
A stimulating super Space Shuttle shooter. The game seems heavily influenced by the arcade classic, Astro Blaster. The Omega 4 Square Sphere space ship, built with new and exotic scientific techniques, was destined for the exploration of the newly discovered Zone 8, being particularly feared due to the alien forces that populate it. But an unexpected threat is headed for the eastern United States and the ship is the only one that can intervene in time! Waves of meteorites that intend to rain down on the earth and create an extinction event. Destroy all the meteorites, you are the only hope for the world. 

Published in Italy as New York Attack, shortened to Attak in Poke n.13 (maggio 1986).

180365.overview: This cave adventure will be gross, brutal and dangerous. Face death, use your brains to light your way, fight Goblins, dragons and win the gold!

180366.overview:
A real LIFE game. This game gives you the chance to play with the Little Computer Person who lives inside your C64. It is fun and totally interactive. Just tell your little computer friend what to do, relax and enjoy the show.  

Commodore 64 Crap Game Compo 2004 (C64CGC)

180374.overview: A text adventure based on the original game by Rod Rudd and published in Loadstar #013. A simple text adventure using a two word parser where you explore the dungeon of the Necromancer. The Necromancer has returned, as he had promised.

180376.overview: A Breakout\Pong style game apparently made with the Breakout Construction Kit. All the baddies of Arkanoid without any of the power-ups.

180385.overview: An Arkanoid style game made with the Breakout Construction Kit. Unlike the original Negaris, this one does have power-UPs, but without the awesome music. More levels of challenge.

180386.overview: An Arkanoid style game, the final entry in the Negaris trilogy of pong\breakout\Arkanoid games created with the Breakout Construction Kit. An improved and bugfixed version was released by Wanderer in 2006 that included a true high-score saver, Trainer and restored the hidden music and the edit options to the game.

180390.overview: A worm/snake type game published in Loadstar #018, and the Best of Loadstar #2.

180405.overview: Turn the entire screen dark without hitting an already darkened square.

180407.overview:
Nono Pixie is a Nonogram Puzzle Game for Commodore 64 with 100 unique puzzles to solve! A Nonogram is a puzzle that tells how many squares are in each row and column of a picture. If there are multiple groups in a column or row this is indicated by multiple numbers for the same column or row. 

Released as part of the RGCD C64 16KB Cartridge Game Development Competition 2019.

180408.overview: A Lunar Lander type game released under several names, Nuclear Attack, Delta Race and finally Destruction with Robtek. In this game it is the year 3060 and an excavation in the great northern desert has triggered an ancient 20th century nuclear missile. It is due to launch in 5 minutes. In order to detonate the missile and save the earth, you must enter the subterranean silo, negotiate the passages and attach an explosive. Once set, you have 2 minutes to get clear.

180411.overview: Mission Briefing: A terrorist group, called 'Red Section' have captured a huge nuclear missile and they threaten to launch it, and destroy the world. Nuclear war has broken out! As part oft he nuclear strike force, you must fly into the outside border of the states and locate a missile which can be located at a top secret location on the red island. Shoot any enemy on sight and pick up blips for weapons.

182323.overview: Boulder Dash in 20 Caves on 5 levels. this one is truly unreal.

182416.overview: Contains caves of several games from Peter Liepa, American Action, No One, Blockheads, Don Pedro and Dr. Watson. A total of 300 caves over 5 levels. Not to be confused with Boulder Dash XVI by the Blockheads.

182944.overview: No One lives in Belgium and created some amazing Boulder Dash games. This one has 20 caves over 5 levels.

182945.overview: The final game in the No One's Boulder game series, created by No One who hails from Belgium and was part of the Replica Copy Crew. 20 caves in total in this version.

188798.overview: The Nightmare is a pinball game for up to 4 players (alternating turns). It was created by SJF using Olaf Lubeck's Pinball Construction Set.

188802.overview: BASIC language Miniature golf game published by Fontana Paperbacks as a type-in from their book Giant Book of Games for You Commodore 64.

190945.overview: A SEUCK based shoot'em up game where it is you vs the martian invaders. Published in ECP's "Gold Ribbon Game Pak".

193529.overview:
Abandoned in space following a catastrophic accident on the Neptune One mining vessel you drift from colony to colony in search of supplies and the hope of finding other survivors.

Guide your Neptune Lander spaceship through 40 perilous caverns, avoiding lasers, dodging malfunctioning doors and traversing dangerous thrust-free EMP zones. Safely land in each colony collecting power-ups on the way before continuing your journey.

Play for survival using the basic ship and landing on the easy to reach bases or take the hard route and prove that you are ready to join the Neptune Lander Elite.

194302.overview: The Noun is an educational game that tests the user on his/her knowledge of nouns in their various forms. It was developed by published by Micro-Ed, Inc. in 1982.

195750.overview: You might call this the prequel to the "Borodino: 1812 - Napoleon in Russia" game put out by Krentek Software the same year as this one, as this battle happened the day before that larger engagement.

199306.overview: A Worm\Snake cousin of GNAFU where you navigate through mazes filled with lozenges. Don't bite your tail and watch out for time.

199428.overview:
NewQuarts is a clone of Tetris for the Commodore 64. It was developed by CR and published by Markt & Technik in 64'er Spielesammlung #5.

The game has three modes of play, up to six players (alternating turns) and is switchable between German and English.

199953.overview: You start at the bottom of the ocean in a wrecked Nuclear Sub. There is literally no way to go but up! Save the ship, raise her, or get out of her before she blows or starts WWIII! Warning, this game plotted by Bob Retelle, Rodger Olsen and a mystery friend is a stone cold killer from three of the nastiest minds in adventure writing.

200069.overview: Noxus is a vertical scrolling shooter developed by Alf Yngve using SEUCK. It was released as part of the 2014 SEUCK Competition. It was also released as part of Commodore Free #080.

200369.overview: This is a shuffleboard style game for 2 players. Each player has 4 counters, each player has different colored counters. The computer will ask the players the row they would like to place the counter in. Then you must press the F7 key and the longer you hold it the farther the counter will slide. You must vary the rows you are allowed to use. Published as a game of "The Big 100" collection.

200703.overview: A game by Dirk Schmitt of S.H.I.T. that was a remake of The Ultimate Search Game with a nicer interface and improved speed. In this game try to find the indicated pattern in the proverbial haystack of dots. If pattern recognition is your thing, this game will be a cinch! Commodore Scene #22

201358.overview:
Nave is a Spanish language "avoid it" game in which uses pseudo-vector graphics. You play a ship that must avoid other smaller similar looking ships for as long as you can.

This was published in Commodore Computer Club N°13 in 1986.

202081.overview:
Ninja Carnage – Commodore 64

The game is a 2 disk side adventure game / semi-textual / Point & click / Die & retry.

Your mission, to help a Ninja kill the yakuza boss. But there are two problems. First, the Ninja is very “bad ass”. He has a very special sense of humour and he thinks you are a total loser. He is very irreverent.

The second problem is that the final boss is hidden very deep in a temple and your trip will lead you through supernatural situations.

The gameplay is die and retry, meaning that each error will lead the Ninja to death.

There are 29 levels in the game. The texts are more than 10 000 words and there are 128 different deaths for the Ninja.
He got reasons to be angry.

The game is translated into 7 languages (English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Greek and Polish).

The story is based on japanese culture, historical facts and ghost stories. The yokai are supernatural creatures in the japanese folklore. You’ll face many challenges, but I’m sure you’ll both be victorious…or not.

Code: Christophe Kohler (aka Oriens)
Music/Sound: Aaron Hickman (aka Dya)
Graphics: Dávid Vigh (aka Grass)

205096.overview:
This is a C64 port of the amazing MSX game Night Knight. C64 code, graphics and sound by Aris Kavalos. Original MSX version by the legendary  Juan J. Martinez.

Sir Bernard is cursed. The only way he can get some sleep at night is by taking a long walk, which is not easy at all when you live in an enchanted castle! 

Can you help him complete all 80 stages and break the curse?

206679.overview: A Worm\Snake game published in COMPUTE! 1984/04 (Issue #47) and in the Street Games "Red Box" release in Australia and New Zealand. The game is featuring Nerm the Worm, who is trapped in Bemer Castle and would like nothing more than to escape (and consume a generous helping of "magic mushrooms" along the way). Yet another variation on Snake where the player controls a serpentine crawler in perpetual motion, which must be guided to consume food, dodge deadly walls, and avoid biting its own tail. The castle is composed of eleven rooms, each trickier to navigate than the last. In a vaguely Carrollian manner, the rooms are prone to sprouting mushrooms which cause Nerm to grow as he eats them: after consuming five mushrooms, the exit doors will open, leading to the next room. Extra lives are awarded along the way, presumably another effect of the magical fungi.

207509.overview:
Nixy is a glade sprite charged with looking after the Gaia stone. The Gaia stone is the heart of the Glade and gives life to the plants and flowers.

But something is wrong with the stone, its been corrupted and now once beautiful flowers are turning dangerous and the once friendly Mushroom people are attacking!

The Old Ones talk of a pool of water which in ages past cleansed the stone. Maybe that might work again?

Travel through the forest avoiding deadly plants and creatures to find the sacred pool and cleanse the stone, then return it to the Guardian Tree in the Glade.

207965.overview:
Night of the Valkyrie is part of the Valkyrie trilogy of horror themed SEUCK games developed by Eleanor Burns.

This one was released as part of the 2016 SEUCK competition, where it tied for second place,

207968.overview: Night Life is a horror themed text adventure for the Commodore 64. It was developed by William Quinn using the GAC (Graphic Adventure Creator) the year of release is 1983.

208477.overview: Part of the long running Belgian Boulder Dash series by No One, released in 1987. This release still uses the original Boulder Dash engine and graphic sets, but gives 20 cunning new caves to master on 5 levels.

208571.overview: Another treat from the Belgian bombshell, called No One, for your spelunking delight. A set of 20 caves using the PLCK Boulder Dash engine created by different makers and compiled by No One with a special twist which allowed a surprise effect: Every time you play, the caves are different. Over a million different variations of play!! Originally published in 1987 and then updated and re-released in late 1988. The game was originally released in 2 parts, but eventually at least 24 were part of the Delight series.

208693.overview: Another BoulderDash game given to us by No One of the Replica Copy Crew with 20 new caves over 5 levels of play. Created using a version of the Boulder Dash Construction Kit and the BD1 engine.

208703.overview: Another No One's Boulder from the Belgian Boulder braniac. Another 20 caves over 5 levels using the original BD engine. there is also a version of this floating around that is instead a compilation of previous No One's games including No One's BD 1-11, Boulderhead 1 and No One's Boulder 1-5 and Surprise Boulder. In any case, hours of fun for Boulder Heads and Rockfordettes.

209205.overview: Naddando is a game inspired by the great C64 classic Commando, a new game in honour of that particular classic on its 35th anniversary.  Furthermore not only is this latest game created by Commodore Spain regarded as a shooter in an aquatic environment, but it also has nods to other games like Rambo Part II or Ikari Warriors within the limitations of the used engine created for this particular game....

209262.overview: Nashiro Hazu: La Foresta Incantata is the first of three Italian language graphic text adventures in the Nashiro Hazu series. This was developed by Alessandro Zanello and published in Adventure Time n.1 (05/1986)

209263.overview:
Nashiro Hazu: La Roccia del Destino is the second game in Alessandro Zanello's Nashiro Hazu trilogy.

This game was released in Adventure Time n.2 (06/1986).

209265.overview:
Nashiro Hazu: La Fortezza del Dragone is the final game in Alessandro Zanello's Nashiro Hazu trilogy.

This was released in Adventure Time n.3 (07/1986).

209329.overview:
English:

National Soccer is a 1991 German language public domain single player football/soccer management simulation for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Marco Fenner and published in Digital Marketing PD #249.

209330.overview: Naughty Nudger is a  fruit/slot machine simulation for the Commodore 64. The developer and year of release are currently unknown.

210592.overview:
Neagox is a Commodore 64 h-scrolling shoot'em up game released in 1990 by Commodore Disk User, it was published in Commodore Disk User 1990/11, and in Your Commodore 1991/04 (Tape #16). NEAGOX

THE NEAGOX PLOT In the year 2020 the earth has become so polluted that most people are dying of different strange diseases. Every time a new child is born it's mutated. Therefore the earth's government decided that the earth's population had to move to some other planet if mankind should survive. Three years later, in the year 2023, the first planet was colonized. From then on mankind colonized more than 11 planets in 30 years. Your planet NEAGOX was colonized as planet no.8 in the year 2044. Some 40 years later an alien ace arrived on earth... It was the Zyxonions. They came in peace and people had belief in them. But then one day the Zyxonions showed their real intentions and took over the world. After which the Zyxonions took over the world government-no longer allowing people to live a decent life with their strict rule. 

The Government of the colonized planets eventually joined forces and made a defensive pact which involved a group of special fighter pilots. This group was called TERRORFORCE (032) and the headquarters were situated on NEAGOX. A couple of years after this pact was made, the Zyxonions began to attack the colonized planets. The newly trained TERRORFORCE fighter pilots were sent to destroy the Zyxonions but they were destroyed one by one. Now, this is where you take over!!! You are the last of the fighter pilots and you have to win the final battle on your planet NEAGOX. Do you have to what it takes to free the human race from enslavement of the Zyxonions????

211165.overview: A math-centric educational game created by Vince Apps and published in 1984 in the book "40 Educational Games for the Commodore 64". This is a game where you have to think ahead and predict the next numbers to appear on the screen. Your computer will start to print a string of numbers such as 1 1 , 22, 33, 44 and will then stop and ask you to predict the next numbers which are, of course, 55. As soon as you think you know the next number, press any key to stop the sequence then type in your answer and press RETURN. The correct answer will be rewarded by scoring a point on the board and a wrong answer will mean that the computer will show you the right number before moving on to the next string of numbers. Remember that the quicker you stop the sequence, the more points you score. As soon as you reach 50 points, the computer will stop and give you your average score.

213515.overview: Negatron is a 1-2 player competitive puzzle/strategy game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Lech Balcerzak and published by public domain label Digimag-Poland in 1990. This was the only game released by Digimag-Poland, as it was released on their first and only disk/BBS mag. The rest of the software they released was either demos or system utilities.

215507.overview: Night Mission is a 1988 logical brain/puzzle game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Barbara H. Schulak and released in LoadStar #54.

216276.overview: A Worm\Snake\Nibbler game for one person created in 1984 by G. Reimuth & U. Schönewolf  and released in Courbois Software #6420, Digital Marketing PD #098 and in Italy in Super Game 2000 N°03 (Aprile 1985), Top 30 N°2. Eat the dots without snacking on your own tail, but the more you eat, the longer you get!

216277.overview: An updated and expanded version of Nibbly 92, like its predecessor, it is a worm/nibble/snake game, where the player controls a growing snake while eating dots in an enclosed maze. The maze is contained on a single screen, and the snake must eat all the dots without being blocked by its own body, in order to get to the next screen with a new maze. Each level increases the difficulty for the player by increasing the snake growth, until eventually the maze becomes impossible to solve. Achievements: C64 Game Competition at C64 Power Game Mod Compo :  #4.

216380.overview: Niedziela Cudów is a football management game. The game allows you to choose one team from the Polish first league. The game contains very basic club's finance options, such as buying and selling players or ticket pricing. Incomes are fully connected with current league position. There is no graphic presentation of the match or text comments. During the match only three information are displayed: elapsing time, time of scoring a goal and current match score.

216381.overview: A one or two player fighting game created by Stefan Gutsch and published in GO64! 1997/04. In it, the 7-up spots fight to the death, which of course is utter and complete nonsense.

218105.overview:
Night Raid is a fixed screen shooter similar to imagic's Atlantis for the Commodore 64. It was developed by an unknown coder and published in the February 1989 issue of Ahoy! Magazine. 

During this time, the magazine had switched to a disk only format.

218148.overview: A new arcade racing conversion of Rally-X  by Jake79 with music by Merman and sound effects by NM156. The original game Rally-X was an overhead maze game released in the 1980's by Namco in which you drove around a maze like screen collecting flags for a high score and avoiding other cars or well play placed rocks. Use your smoke screens and your wile to grab the flags without getting hit by the kamikaze baddies. And don't forget to keep an eye on your gas tank and keep it filled when you can.

219127.overview: Its an endless runner game themed around my two Dogs "Nico" and "Aston", Nico was not well at the time this Game Jam was running, and my viewers and I did not want to replicate the game, we wanted to use the essence of the game and create a new game, so its about Nico trying to run away from his brother Aston, as Aston would not leave him alone while he was unwell. In the game you jump over trees, kennels and stumps, collect bones, shields and cookies. Avoid UFOs and Aston. Game created for Game Jam organized by Phaze101's Retro Programmers Inside Group (RPI).

219971.overview: A homebrew civilian aircraft flight simulation game created by Tim Gerchmez and released to PD in 1985.

417739.overview: NewsStand is a new game for Commodore 64 (made by AGPX and Phobos), in which our hero Joseph has to collect the money in order to buy cassette tapes with the legendary games for the C64, but many enemies will try to stop him! In Italy, in the 80s, these cassettes were sold on newsstands and it was a thrill every time to return home and try them all. In memory of those magical moments, we made this video game.

418592.overview: Nyordax is a strange little horizontal shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Manuel Gómez Alcaide and released as part of the Commodoremania 2016 Compo.

421036.overview: You are the last hope of the gentle people of Gradius. You've just lifted off to confront the all-out attack of the amoeboid Bacterions. Your hyper-space fighter is armed with the greatest arsenal in the galaxy. Air-to-surface and double beam laser cannons for incredible firepower. Powerful force fields for protection. Time and space warps for fleeing the dimension. You'll need it all just to survive. Because at the heart of the Bacterion Empire lies the Xaerous Superfortress - the nerve center of the all-knowing, all-seeing Bacterion Bio-Computer. It's a duel to the death, while the entire galaxy watches, waits, and hopes!

421110.overview: You are the youngest member of the Garrot Guild, or what is left of it. Most of those loyal to the Duke were killed after the brutal and unexpected Lyrin invasion that so changed the land you were born in.

424068.overview:
NATO Course is a 1988 helicopter themed vertically scrolling shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by King M.D. using Chris Yates Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit, and released in the following:

•   Digital Marketing PD #077
•   Stonysoft #0160

425526.overview: Nurikabe is a purely logic based puzzle game with three basic rules. The zip file contains the game and also contains some documents to get you started. You can read up on the puzzle itself on wikipedia: Nurikabe (hiragana: ぬりかべ) is a binary determination puzzle named for Nurikabe, an invisible wall in Japanese folklore that blocks roads and delays foot travel. Nurikabe was apparently invented and named by the publisher Nikoli; other names (and attempts at localization) for the puzzle include Cell Structure and Islands in the Stream.

444278.overview:
Night Mission Pinball Extended, released in 2024, is a remake of the classic game originally launched by subLOGIC in 1982.

The game features a multiball mechanic, allowing players to have four balls on the screen simultaneously. While the original 1MHz C-64 struggles with this demand, significant optimizations have been implemented compared to the original release. Additionally, the game now offers a 2MHz mode in the border area utilizing the $d030 register to enhance speed. Remarkably, even with the standard C64, players can enjoy nearly identical speed with three balls as they would with just one. For owners of a C128 or other CPU speeder leveraging the $d030 register, a smooth 50Hz gameplay experience is attainable, even with four balls on the playfield.

447585.overview: Not to be confused with the text adventure of the same name, Nightmare by JR-Soft is a 1-player single-screen platform game. The game was developed in 1987, however, it was not released until 1988. It was published in by Tronic-Verlag in Compute mit 1988/06.

451578.overview:
The sun has died and dense darkness has flooded the realms, laden with frightening creatures. Merely the mythic Fortified Citadel is a safe heaven in this cursed land. Unfortunately, few are welcomed within its holy walls: only the first who reaches it will find the gates wide open; the others will have to wander in darkness, forever...
 
 
THE NIGHTLAND is a text-based "board & video" game for COMMODORE 64 and PLUS/4 inspired by the works of William Hope Hodgson and Otto Wlazlo's dungeon-synth album released by Heimat der Katastrophe. You'll need a 6-sided die and pawns to play. The pawns start from outside the board and advance rolling the die. You control your character while the CPU brings to life your opponent and the desolate land with all its strange creatures. Experience the events on the board and discover new threats hidden within the 8-bit code!

452238.overview: 2024 Reset64 4KB Craptastic Game Competition entry. When you reach a very deep sleep, you can't escape from a spooky nightmare. Ghosts will take over your dark and scary house, you must escape from them. Your only safe zone is to stay under the light, that's when the ghosts disappear. Take the key and find the exit door.

452282.overview:
Join Nixy once again as she embarks on a new quest to find the source of the corruption threatening her home in the Glade.

Explore mysterious caverns and crumbling castle ruins while avoiding ghouls, knights and other obstacles as she searches for clues and allies to aid her in her quest!

Nixy's adventures will take her across the Glade, up to the castle towers and down below the hidden caverns. Can you help her save her home once again?

453612.overview: The New Jump for the Commodore 64  is a logical puzzle/board game for 1 player. The game was developed by Tobias Erbsland and released into the public domain in 1992.

456475.overview: An undersea text adventure game. You have found the magic plug that belongs at the bottom of the sea, and your quest is to put it back before the waters all drain away...

456651.overview:
Nagasyan is a single-player seuck game created by Roberto Ricioppo of TND.

Shoot aliens and score as many points where possible.

456732.overview:
No, it’s not that same old boring game that you play when it’s raining outside and there is nothing else to do.

With our noughts and crosses you have to solve a problem before you can make your mark on your computer’s board. You will have to decide if you can answer the question before you choose your box. 
 
From the book "40 Educational Games for the Commodore 64"

459394.overview: A Hungarian language shoot em up which placed 4th in the Árok 2025 Game Dev competition.

462472.overview: In a dark corner of the world, where the night never ends, lives Nikolav, a vampire as brave as he is charming. But the tranquility of his castle is disrupted when Frankenstein, driven mad by an impossible love, kidnaps his beloved Lunara and locks her deep within his fortress.

472677.overview: Help the kid to get above the blu line (or the top of the screen) to escape a level. To do that you must arrange the falling blocks, Tetris style, so that the kid can jump up on them. But don't let the blocks crush the kid! Or the blocks reach the top of the playfield...

474590.overview: You're the night-shift operator of a nuclear reactor, and the core wants to kill you. Every alarm shoves all three gauges toward disaster

476640.overview: In storm-swept skies, in blackest night, nobody lost shall escape my light.

476658.overview: Step into the role of the last time mage in this PETSCII dungeon crawler! Battle your way through the chasms of the Neon Labyrinth, collect treasures, and defeat the monsters!

480241.overview:

Weapon bonuses and surprise enemies.

For C64 / 128, Ultimate and emulators.

CRT, D64 and PRG files.

480611.overview: Fly your magic carpet and collect scrolls.

481067.overview: Guide a tiny glowing adventurer through the hidden world inside your C64. Jump between platforms, kick off walls and dash through the air. Each room is a small movement challenge on the way to your missing half.

481406.overview: NOT 1942 is a vertically scrolling shoot-'em-up for the Commodore 64, inspired by the arcade classic 1942 and written from scratch in 6502 assembly.

481629.overview: Look after a planet of four colonies that learn by themselves (each one with its own Neutro brain) and defend it with your ship from a boss that learns from your deaths.

481703.overview: A horizontal shooter about going in the wrong end and blasting your way out of the other.

481933.overview: Unofficial c64 port from sharp Mz-800

482069.overview: The vulture fleet has struck the outer rim. Take off from 7 Towers Base and fly through seven worlds - night valley, red desert, frozen world, nebula, ocean, factory and the dead nebula - shoot down wave after wave, and face a  different boss at the end of every world, up to the Leader of the Vultures himself.

482171.overview: The year is 2188. In the Belgian megacity of New Antwerp the corporations own everything: the harbours, the police and even the memories of their workers.

482201.overview: A puzzle game in the Lemmings tradition for the Commodore 64

482764.overview: Enjoy some classic pinball on your favorite home computer of all times!

482917.overview: Made by machine, start to finish. The idea for Nightcat came from an AI, not from a person. The AI made up the game, wrote every line of code, drew every pixel, composed every note and wrote this page. No human came up with anything here: nobody dreamed up the game, nobody counted cycles, nobody fought the SID, nobody loved the machine. One prompt, and the AI was given a time limit of thirty minutes to finish it. It is here to hold up a mirror to the proud “AI game creators”: typing a prompt and waiting is not an achievement. It's nothing, just like these games are nothing.

482919.overview: duel a rival light cycle on a neon grid and trap them before they trap you.
